bluetooth.note: the same keyboard, detached and paired; HID bus type 0005 (Bluetooth)

bluetooth.touchpadTwoFingerScroll.reason: Raw HID capture over Bluetooth (hidraw, report 5 = buttons, X, Y, wheel, AC pan): one finger 904 reports, two-finger vertical swipes 47 reports and two-finger horizontal 3, with 0 wheel and 0 pan reports; over USB the same firmware sends wheel events. Neither the USB nor the Bluetooth descriptor has a precision touchpad collection or a gesture setting; feature report 9 returns 25 random-looking bytes and 0x13 is not answered over Bluetooth.
